name: Lista USD
oneLiner: lisUSD is Lista DAO's BNB Chain stablecoin, with crypto-collateralized CDPs, documented USDT/USDC PSM minting and credit-based D3M issuance.
collateral: BNB, ETH, liquid-staking tokens, BTCB and additional issuer-listed GemJoin assets support CDPs. Issuer PSM documentation names USDT and USDC for nominal 1:1 minting; FDUSD is separately listed as CDP collateral. D3M is a distinct credit-based direct-deposit exposure.
pegMechanism: PSM enabling 1:1 swaps with centralized stablecoins; CDP overcollateralization and liquidation
